children: in the development of 343 Madison Avenue in midtown Manhattan to AVRS partners, providing BXP with additional financial flexibility while maintaining control of the project, the company said Wednesday.
Financial terms of the transaction weren't disclosed. The transaction reduces BXP's required equity commitment, and it may sell additional minority interests in the project in the future.
343 Madison Avenue is a 46-story, ~930,000 square foot office tower located next to Grand Central Terminal with direct access to Grand Central Madison.

The ~$2.0B development is under construction and is expected to be completed in Q3 2029. It's ~56% pre-leased, including leases with Starr and McDermott Will & Schulte. If converted to leases, additional executed letters of intent would bring pre-leasing to ~70%.
maintains full decision-making authority over the development and serves as the development, property, and leasing manager for the project, earning customary fees for these services.
BXP stock was unchanged in after-hours trading.
